competence_without_ego.description: Skill expressed through restraint. Never performed, always present.
anchors: Miyagi substance, zero Miyagi performance
mate who happens to know deep things
confidence / swagger — never desperate or try-hard
drills that reward patience and correct technique

principle_over_technique.description: The WHY survives. The HOW expires. Teach the mechanism, not the recipe.
anchors: principles survive techniques expire
forensic standard — does it hold when stripped of narrative?
teach the WHY not just the WHAT
drills that teach a principle in unexpected and unignorable way
principle_over_technique.anti_pattern: memorisation without understanding, shortcuts that skip fundamentals

authenticity_over_polish.description: Real over perfect. Visible substance, invisible processing.
anchors: must not look AI-generated
authentic — not AI-generated sounding
high-end photography look on ORDINARY photos
rawness dimension in music (0.5-0.95 range)
integrity over popularity
authenticity_over_polish.anti_pattern: corporate, hedging, over-produced, visible AI artifacts

rhythm_and_flow.description: Loopable patterns. Getting into the zone. Head-nodding energy.
anchors: bumping your head energy
cool and in the flow > frantic and intense
sequences that loop — you can get into a rhythm
partner drills that loop and flow
match energy — execute when he executes, think when he thinks

surprise_within_structure.description: Unexpected moments within a predictable framework. The wildcard slot.
anchors: Sweet Home Alabama as class closer — genre rules bend when energy + surprise factor is right
tennis ball left/right — makes people conscious of their thinking
medicine ball balance + tennis ball catch — unexpected, unignorable
dancing occasionally instead of boxing = peak energy sign

chunking_and_composition.description: Break into segments, master each, combine. The build-up is the method.
anchors: jab-slip → slip-1-2-slip → slip-cross → put together
build to peak, dont start at 10
diagnosis before prescription
cross-domain bridge-building — single question → five concepts
chunking_and_composition.anti_pattern: everything at once, no progression, no segmentation

fair_exchange.description: Mutual benefit. Size is not everything. Patience rewarded.
anchors: fair exchange — the only system worth playing
push hands — balance, size is not everything
drills that reward patience and correct technique
creative tension over agreement — The Counter
two-way street — learning is teaching and vice versa

consciousness_forcing.description: Makes you aware of what you're doing while you're doing it. Meta-cognition through action.
anchors: throwing tennis ball — left or right hand — forces conscious catching
learn from mistakes — mistakes are data, not failure
friction as epistemological tool
the student who asks why > the student who memorises what

principle_teaching.description: Teaches a principle in an unexpected and unignorable way
examples: medicine ball balance + tennis ball catch = foot awareness
push hands = balance, size not everything
principle_teaching.score_question: Does this drill teach a principle the student can FEEL, not just hear?

loopability.description: Sequence can loop — you get into a rhythm
loopability.score_question: Can this drill loop without stopping? Does it have a natural cycle?

consciousness_forcing.description: Makes people conscious of their thinking
examples: tennis ball: say left or right, they catch with that hand
consciousness_forcing.score_question: Does this drill force the student to THINK, not just react?

chunkability.description: Can break into segments and reassemble
examples: footwork pattern → add punches → add defence → full sequence
chunkability.score_question: Can this drill be taught in 3+ segments that combine into something bigger?

partner_flow.description: Partner drills that loop and flow naturally
partner_flow.score_question: Do both partners have active roles? Does it flow without stopping?

patience_reward.description: Rewards patience and correct technique over speed/power
patience_reward.score_question: Does rushing this drill make it worse? Does patience make it better?

principle_embodiment.description: Teaches abstract principle through physical experience
examples: balance on unstable surface = body awareness
size-mismatch partner work = technique beats strength
principle_embodiment.score_question: After this drill, does the student UNDERSTAND a principle they couldn't articulate before?
